items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: We had to leave Dominic there. We left Dominic there until we got to Long Beach.

ctx.x: We had to leave Dominic there. We left Dominic there until we got to Long Beach. They kept him in the hospital two weeks. I can't think of that band leader's name, one of the greatest men there was. Then I had the pleasure of shaking hands with the man that made C.G. Conn's first Wonderhorn. That was, uh, the man had the band in Long Beach.
